why: The settings are right but in the wrong place: the learner made settings.json at the top of recipe-box (the breadcrumb says recipe-box > settings.json) instead of in a .vscode folder. VS Code reads workspace settings only from .vscode/settings.json, so format on save is still off and the tab size is still 4 in this folder.

step.title: Turn on format on save for this folder
step.instructions: Create .vscode/settings.json in recipe-box (a folder named .vscode, then settings.json inside it) and set "editor.formatOnSave": true and "editor.tabSize": 2. These are workspace settings: they apply only to this folder.

precision_checks.label: The workspace settings file sets format on save

hints: The folder name starts with a dot: .vscode.
common_mistakes: Putting the settings in User settings, which apply to every folder.
